address: 433 Guxi Road, Gulou, Fuzhou, China Mainland
bio: The owner is a returnee from Australia who has worked closely with the chef to develop two tasting menus that mirror the seasons. The menus bear a strong European slant and star first-rate produce from around the world with occasional local ingredients such as Fuzhou condiments like red wine lees and sa cha sauce. The compact dining room sports a casual continental vibe, perfect for date nights and friendly get-togethers....
